verdict.rationale: The evidence shows prompt version tracking with a 'compare versions' capability and rollback. It also shows response scoring and evaluation via webhooks, plus a playground for iterating on prompts. None of it documents running evals and viewing run results side by side to spot regressions; scoring appears to depend on external webhook integrations. Missing for 10: a first-class eval-run or experiment comparison view, side-by-side scores across prompt or model versions, regression detection between runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
